title: Looking for Windmill tile sets or something like it

posts.author: spades141
posts.body: The problem i have being new to rpg maker is making parts of the game then realizing i need to figure out how to make the map for it. During a quest they have to make their way to the windmill where an npc is at. she will be in danger and the fight will happen out side of said windmill. i saw a few windmills for overworld but this will be on an outside map i think. anyone have any tile sets or ideas on how i can build this map. Rpg maker mz

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Winlu's farm tileset has an animated windmill:
https://winlu.itch.io/winlu-farm-tileset
Otherwise if you can't find anything, you could always just not show the upper part of it. Have the supposed windmill be on top of the map, just showing the entrance basically, which would make it just like any other building.

posts.author: Ariyana
posts.body:
PandaMaru has a windmill tileset, you can find it here
windmill-tileset
and here
windmill-arms
To use it, you must own the MV.
